integrity_notes: Original analytic claim supported by a self-contained proof; Fu vertex polynomial and kernel convergence are used as published inputs, not re-attributed. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The Bergman-kernel nonvanishing conclusion concerns fixed exponents with a non-endpoint vertex parameter and sufficiently small positive product variable; it is not a global Lu Qi-Keng result.
At endpoint alpha=1 the limiting polynomial has unimodular zeros; the closed-core finite-parameter conclusion is not asserted there.
The all-degree root theorem is proved analytically; computational checks are finite supplements, and older unindexed equivalent stability results cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp exterior zero barrier and radial escape for generalized-Hartogs vertex kernels
